notes.title: 【Version 1.0.4】Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear passengers,

We have been working hard to address the pressing issues that you have brought to our attention and to improve your gaming experience. Below are the details of this update: 

[list]
[*] Modified the text for the save function: Changed "Create New Save" to "Start New Game" to prevent players from confusing this as a save function and accidentally overwriting their progress.
[*] Added the "Skip Prologue Tutorial" feature: After completing the prologue tutorial once, you can now use the "Skip Prologue Tutorial" feature when starting the prologue with other save files.
[*] Streamlined the prologue scenes, eliminating the need to reexperience certain repetitive plot points.
[*] Introduced guidance to enhance the puzzle-solving experience for the "Auction Quest."
[*] Adjusted level guidance to enhance the puzzle-solving experience for the "Enter the Communication Room Quest."
[*] Trimmed certain scenes in the Javert storyline - Factory level.
[*] Corrected typos in certain dialogue texts.
[/list]
 
If you have any suggestions or feedback about the game, please feel free to connect with us through the social media buttons on the in-game homepage. By clicking on them, you can join the respective community and interact with us. 
We would like to extend our heartfelt appreciation to all the players who offered their valuable feedback. Here's to you! 🍻

notes.title: FQA before release
notes.notes:
1、About our team
We are StarryStarry, an indie game studio. A Guidebook Of Babel is our first title.

2、When will the game be unlocked on Steam?
The game will be unlocked on August 2, 2023 7:00 PM PDT.

3、About the price
The game is priced at 12.7 USD after the first-week discount.

4、Does your game support experience on Steam Deck?
You can play normally on Steam Deck.

5、Does your game support experience on Mac OS?
You can enjoy the game on your Mac.

6、Does the game support cloud save？
Yes.

7、The required space of the game is only 300MB. How long can we play this game?
8-10 hours.

8、Does the game have multiple endings and branches?
No, the game has only one ending.The player seems to be playing a detective who is searching for the road to this ending in the fog.

9、What is the inspiration for game production?
A small incident from the past led me to imagine this bizarre world after death. I hope this world can provide you with a different perspective to think about life and regret.

10、In addition to the standard edition of the game, will there be DLC or deluxe edition?
There will be a deluxe edition, which includes the game itself, the original soundtrack and the digital artbook collection. Buying the deluxe edition will be more cost-effective than buying the above three separately.
